sourceAndStyles: Based on the pinned upstream source; shared components, layout and identity theme adapted for Actvero.

localChanges.change: Added shadcn new-york-v4 InputGroup on 2026-09-26 via registry view; adapted imports to local cn and existing Button/Input/Textarea, no dependency changes.

Added shadcn new-york-v4 Progress on 2026-09-25 after registry dry-run/view. Adapted cn import and standalone @radix-ui/react-progress 1.1.16 to existing Radix setup; forwards value to Root for accessible progress semantics.
Default floating sidebar with expanded layout; original theme mechanisms retained.
Reuse and compose shared controls for organization navigation, member tables/dialogs, account cards, avatar sizes and password fields.
Replace sample business routes with real setup, OIDC login, member invitations/direct creation, audit and personal settings.
Authenticated organization guards and actual business routes; remove mock sign-in and Clerk routes.
Typed FastAPI contract and CSRF-protected requests.
FastAPI identity milestone with PostgreSQL migrations, Keycloak integration and permission/isolation tests.
Independent Keycloak configuration; theme generated from shared frontend controls and compiled styles.

Replaced the template mark and web/identity favicons with the existing Actvero linked-forms brand on 2026-09-29. Local geometry snapshot drives React, Keycloak and SVG favicon; existing theme retained. Provenance and asset hashes: docs/BRANDING.md.
